launch_decisions.configuration: Country, supported markets, currencies, delivery fleets/providers, payment methods, fees, tax and refund policies configurable; no invented activation defaults
launch_decisions.payment_provider: Not selected; provider adapters must be disabled until actual configuration/sandbox verification
launch_decisions.external_delivery: Optional later configuration; not required for first own-fleet path
launch_decisions.policy_rules: Versioned validated configuration; activated rules audited; quotes/orders retain applied version; existing orders not recalculated after a policy edit; zero core food commission invariant cannot be bypassed

initial_launch_dependencies.note: Owner selected own fleet first; FB10 external delivery remains later module, no full-product completion claim.

market_currency_fleet_configuration.country: Configurable launch country and supported markets; MY is the initial selection, not a hard-coded system restriction
market_currency_fleet_configuration.currency: Configurable supported currencies and market/outlet currency; MYR is the initial selection. Validate currency codes and minor-unit precision; never silently convert or mix currencies
market_currency_fleet_configuration.delivery_fleets: Configurable multiple own fleets and external-provider fleets with per-market/outlet eligibility, availability, priority and fallback routing. Own fleet is the initial selection; unconfigured/unverified providers disabled
market_currency_fleet_configuration.activation: Versioned, validated, audited administrative configuration; preserve country/currency/fleet and rule versions on existing quotes/orders/financial records rather than rewriting history
market_currency_fleet_configuration.scope: Runtime configuration and integrations remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no provider or market support claimed solely from an enabled setting

frontend_backend_alignment.contract_source: Complete pinned original Enatega UI across all six applications, including its operations, variables, selected response fields, routes, URLs and realtime interactions.
frontend_backend_alignment.backend_scope: Implement the complete backend required by original frontend workflows; canonical internal services may remain behind explicit, tested compatibility adapters.
frontend_backend_alignment.ui_boundary: Preserve original screens, navigation, layouts, components, assets and interaction flows. Only transport, session, configuration, validated mapping, centralized brand and necessary security/accessibility integration changes are allowed.
frontend_backend_alignment.url_boundary: Preserve frontend route/deep-link contracts. Configure API, websocket, REST, upload and provider return URLs explicitly for each environment; no upstream production fallback. Validate base-path normalization and actual subscription protocol, not only matching hostnames.
acceptance: Every original request validates against the served schema including variables and complete selection sets.
Every reachable action maps to an implemented, authorized domain workflow with real persistence and negative-path evidence.
HTTP, websocket, REST, upload and callback behavior is verified with configured local endpoints.
No fabricated data, default economic success, secret exposure or removal of unsupported actions.
Real original-UI browser workflows and visual checks pass; native flows require device evidence.
Independent QA and security approve each bounded packet; complete product acceptance remains withheld until all workflows pass.
frontend_backend_alignment.static_check_limit: Schema and static limit compatibility are necessary, not proof of runtime reachability, authorization, business correctness, URL behavior or UI parity.
